items.name: Airlie Oak Wilmington Tea Towel
items.alt: Ivory kitchen tea towel printed with a painterly illustration of the Airlie Oak, a Southern live oak with hanging Spanish moss, hanging on an oven handle, shown as an illustrative image
items.meta: A printed kitchen tea towel with a painterly illustration of the Airlie Oak, the roughly 500 year old Southern live oak at Airlie Gardens in Wilmington NC, on warm ivory. Made to order.
facts: Airlie Oak illustration printed on the towel, not embroidered
